name: Kagura Reimeiki ~Maika no Shou~ Ni
original_name: 神楽黎明記 ～舞歌の章～弐
source:
Maika Tohno has become renowned throughout the land for sealing a nine-tailed fox youkai. Midway through another day of training apprentice priestesses, she is offered a shockingly daunting quest—to appease the anger of a dragon god whose shrine was destroyed by a certain village’s plans for tourist-based redevelopment. Incited by the dragon god’s wrath, various youkai have also gone berserk and the villagers are unable to escape the ensuing chaos. To save the villagers, Maika decides to accept and go into battle once more…

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/2802]Shiravune[/url]]
translation:
远野舞歌因封印九尾狐妖而名扬各地。一天，她正在训练见习巫女，却接到了一项艰巨得令人吃惊的委托：平息龙神的怒火。某个村庄为发展旅游业进行改建，毁掉了龙神的神社，因而招致神罚。受龙神怒气影响，各种妖怪也陷入狂乱，村民们被困在随之而来的混乱之中，无法脱身。为了拯救村民，舞歌决定接受委托，再度奔赴战场……

[摘自[url=https://shiravune.com/archives/2802]Shiravune[/url]]
